g.text: Lab 03: API Gateway & Rate-Aware Routing Architecture
Complete Edge Defense Topology: Nginx Reverse Proxy • Map-Based Auth • Token Bucket Rate Quotas • Private Microservice Bridge
How traffic moves through Nginx edge verification, credential validation, upstream reverse-proxying, and quota enforcement
• Checks credential in Nginx map table
• Confirms request is within 5 req/s quota
Clients interact with a single port (8080); internal service
ports are entirely hidden from the outside world.
Unauthorized traffic is blocked at the gateway perimeter,
protecting downstream database and microservice CPU.
Rate limits isolate aggressive consumers, ensuring reliable
quality of service (QoS) for all legitimate API clients.
